name: What is the typical process for GEO website optimization?
description: The process involves an audit, strategy development focusing on local SEO elements, and ongoing monitoring to improve local search performance.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for GEO website optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process for GEO website optimization begins with a comprehensive audit of your current online presence and local search performance. This includes analyzing your Google My Business profile, website content, local citations, and competitor strategies. Following the audit, a tailored strategy is developed focusing on on-page SEO, local keyword integration, technical SEO adjustments, and review management. Regular monitoring and adjustments are then made to adapt to algorithm changes and optimize performance.
